facts.text: The hotel is located on Collins Street in the heart of Melbourne.
facts.excerpt: Welcome to timeless elegance in the heart of Melbourne. Located on prestigious Collins Street, the InterContinental Melbourne the Rialto is an icon of glamour, grandeur and grace.

facts.text: The hotel's glass atrium, ornate windows and original brickwork showcase 1890s neo-Gothic architecture.
facts.excerpt: Our glass atrium, ornate windows and original brickwork showcase 1890s neo-Gothic architecture while our elegant interiors weave a tapestry of contemporary elegance.

facts.text: The hotel is two buildings, the older Gothic Rialto and the Romanesque Winfield Building, linked by a soaring glass ceiling over what was once a wide lane.
facts.excerpt: it is actually two buildings (the older, Gothic Rialto and the Romanesque Winfield Building) linked by a soaring glass ceiling that covers what was once a wide lane.

facts.text: The building is on the National Heritage List.
facts.excerpt: On the National Heritage List, it is actually two buildings

facts.text: The atrium is a spectacle of light, angles, marble, mosaic, bluestone and carefully selected local art.
facts.excerpt: The real star, however, is the enormous atrium, a spectacle of light, angles, marble, mosaic, bluestone, and carefully selected local art.

facts.text: The heated indoor pool and hot tub overlook the Melbourne skyline.
facts.excerpt: Overlooking Melbourne’s iconic skyline, our heated indoor pool and hot tub offer a refined retreat above the city.

facts.text: The rooftop pool has floor-to-ceiling windows with views over the CBD and out to the bay.
facts.excerpt: With sweeping views through the floor-to-ceiling windows over the CBD and out to the bay, our rooftop pool is the perfect place to relax.

facts.text: The pool area is complemented by a Scandinavian-inspired sauna and a light-filled fitness centre.
facts.excerpt: Complemented by a Scandinavian-inspired sauna and a light-filled fitness centre

facts.text: The club lounge offers daily breakfast, afternoon tea, evening canapés and all-day refreshments.
facts.excerpt: the club lounge offers exclusive daily breakfast, indulgent afternoon tea, evening canapés, all day refreshments and bespoke service in an elegant setting.

facts.text: The Signature Suites offer expansive living spaces and bespoke furnishings.
facts.excerpt: our Signature Suites offer an exceptional residential experience with expansive living spaces, bespoke furnishings and elevated comforts.

facts.text: Some suites may include a Collins Street view and a separate jetted bath with walk-in rain shower.
facts.excerpt:
Signature Suite may include:

- Collins Street View

- Separate Jetted Bath with Walk-in Rain Shower

facts.text: Alluvial Restaurant serves seasonal dining beneath the hotel's atrium.
facts.excerpt: Savour seasonal dining beneath the hotel’s soaring atrium at Alluvial Restaurant

facts.text: Bluestone Wine Lounge features fine wines from Victoria and Australia, plus French Champagnes, under the glass atrium.
facts.excerpt: Bluestone Wine Lounge features fine wines from Victoria and Australia.

facts.text: Ronnie's, helmed by chef Matthew Butcher, serves contemporary Italian cuisine and is known for pasta and wine pairings.
facts.excerpt: Rustic chic, the restaurant is most known for its pasta and wine pairings.

facts.text: The location gives access to Melbourne's laneways and luxury boutiques, the National Gallery of Victoria, the MCG and Marvel Stadium.
facts.excerpt: Wander Melbourne’s renowned laneways and luxury boutiques, immerse in the surrounds of art at National Gallery of Victoria or attend sporting and entertainment events at MCG and Marvel Stadium.

facts.text: The concierge can procure tickets to Arts Centre Melbourne and arrange a backstage tour.
facts.excerpt: Our concierge will happily procure tickets to Australia’s largest performing arts venue, and even arrange a backstage tour.

facts.text: Pets are not allowed at the hotel.
facts.excerpt: No, pets are not allowed at InterContinental Melbourne.

facts.text: The hotel calls itself an icon of glamour, grandeur and grace.
facts.excerpt: is an icon of glamour, grandeur and grace

contradictions.note: p1 description says three restaurants and bar; p1/p4 feature list says 2 on-site restaurants

sources.excerpt: dine at one of our three exquisite restaurants and bar
